verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub examples show natural-language goals (e.g., "Find the top Hacker News story", "Fill in this job application") driving an agent that navigates, logs in, handles 2FA/CAPTCHA, and completes multi-step flows end-to-end via both cloud API and open-source library; community reports corroborate real-world use (e.g., LinkedIn automation). Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmark of complex multi-step task success rates and more robust evidence of reliability at scale beyond anecdotal community reports.
